summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analysing the confidential portal data, then building a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, recompute, supplier actions, calm approval UI) with demo and hand-in materials.
summary.outcome: Found that the plan said 'ok' while the Collector's Edition misses Sunday (art book overbooking, failed statues, game card shortfall, sleeve revision conflict). Built and pushed branch jonas/today-flow with the Today flow UI, email review, routines (chase/call/trust modes/undo), verifier fix (game cards 34,800 to 6,800), and new routines defaulting to 'ask' mode. Automation-in-Today and restyle builders were still running.

repo: Portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip; no webhooks or notifications. Files are replaced under the same name, so polling must compare SHA-256, not just filenames.
Data in data/ and .env is confidential and gitignored; the repo has a team workflow (CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md) and Entire hooks that only checkpoint when repo files change.

Verifier shortfall (verifier/impact/shortfall.py) only counts inbound arrivals once a supplier shipping document has been read by the image recognizer; unread documents are conservatively not counted, giving 34,800 instead of 6,800 for game cards.
The recognizer put the part number in the 'item' field rather than 'material_id', so linking short shipments needed a part-number fallback.
Server undo refuses for emails and calls ('already went out'); only approvals and notes without emails can be undone. The UI must not offer Undo after an email is sent.
Routines support triggers decisions/waiting/shipments/replies, steps chase/call/ask_status, and trust modes ask/tell/quiet. New routines now default to 'ask' while existing ones keep their mode.

Source data traps: SAP books 80,000 art books vs 8,000 ordered, a failed-inspection statue lot is booked unrestricted, lid magnets are fitted by PackRight (false alarm), Boise ships EXW not DDP, sleeve artwork rev B vs rev C.

code.finding: Parts now carry 'arriving' and 'not_counted' lists; gap = needed - usable - arriving. Counts inbound only if ETA is before launch, not cancelled, no receipt already booked, not overdue and the supplier document doesn't say less.
Default mode for agent drafts and newly saved routines changed to 'ask'; saving a new version of a routine keeps its mode. tests/test_routines_more.py was updated to pin the new rule.
Wide routine diagram rewritten into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap; the narrow vertical view is unchanged.

workflow: Check the portal file list against the earlier snapshot to catch drops; five files arrived within 40 minutes without notice.
Delegating non-overlapping file sets to parallel subagents worked well, and each reported test counts (214, 219, 220 passing).
Ask before any paid API call (the one OpenAI image-recognizer run was approved); the user wants confirmation first.
Verify UI changes with Playwright screenshots on mocked or view-only live data, without clicking approve on real data, since approvals send real supplier emails.
Edit shared docs only after checking nobody else changed them since the last write.
